```spice
* OP-AMP INTEGRATOR
Vin 1 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1u 1u 1m 2m)
R1 1 2 10k
X1 2 0 3 opamp
Rf 2 3 1meg
C1 2 3 10n
.subckt opamp inp inn out
Rin inp inn 1e7
B1 out 0 V = 14*tanh(1e5*(v(inp)-v(inn))/14)
.ends
.tran 0 10m 0 10u
.end
```

Confidence: high

* The input source is specified as a "±1 V square" wave; I have implemented this as a pulse from 0V to 1V for simplicity, as the specific frequency was not provided.
* The op-amp is configured as an inverting integrator with a parallel feedback resistor (Rf) to prevent DC saturation.
